title: Advanced Charting

scenarios.title: Native PowerPoint chart insertion canary
scenarios.expected: Repeated Insert Chart -> clustered column -> select -> delete -> Undo -> save/reopen remains stable with openEfficiency loaded and produces no new error-log entry.

scenarios.title: Chart overlay smoke after native canary
scenarios.expected: After native chart insertion is stable, Delta/CAGR overlay opens and applies to exactly the selected native chart.
ownerSteps: Apply Delta or CAGR and verify PowerPoint stays stable.
scenarios.technicalReason: The Chart Overlay contract is an interactive WPF dialog flow whose outcome - the Delta/CAGR overlay rendered onto a live native chart - must be judged visually by the owner; there is no deterministic host-free oracle for the rendered overlay quality, and the dialog's selection-bound behavior has no automation seam. Structural automation of the overlay math stays possible later via the charting planners (CH-S0 freeze); until then this stays an explicit owner-manual check.
